methodology.exactness: Every route reconstructs the complete target IPA with complete visible operation readings.
methodology.alternateRequirement: A route must use the tested alternative brick and contain at least two operations; trivial whole-target replacement is excluded.
methodology.strictPreference: Strict routes rank before general routes. General routes remain explicit and visible only.
methodology.activation: No route, lexical lead, pictogram or grapheme is activated by this report.
